inputs.name: CatalogService.constructor.source
inputs.description: A GitSourceAdapter bound to a repository; this service uses it to load manifests and changed paths, and entity details also use its documentation, source, size, and contract-hash methods. The service receives the adapter rather than constructing or reconfiguring it.

inputs.name: CatalogService.constructor.planning
inputs.description: A PlanningPort implementation; this service reads plans for each revision and may read history when opening a planned entity. It does not call the port’s create, design, thread, approval, image, or message methods.

inputs.name: CatalogService.list.revision
inputs.description: Repository revision string used for the manifest, plan, and changed-path reads. The method passes it to its dependencies unchanged and does not validate it itself.

inputs.name: CatalogService.entity.id
inputs.description: Catalog entity identifier matched against the assembled catalog rows for the requested revision. If no row has this exact id, detail loading throws Error.

inputs.name: CatalogService.entity.revision
inputs.description: Repository revision string used to assemble the catalog and load detail data. The method passes it to its dependencies unchanged and does not validate it itself.

outputs.name: CatalogService.list
outputs.description: Resolves to catalog summary rows sorted by title, combining eligible active units with plan records for the revision. Route-loader-only pages and non-planned function rows without a valid helper contract are omitted; details require the entity operation.

outputs.name: CatalogService.entity
outputs.description: Resolves to the detail record for the matching catalog id and revision, including its contract, relationships, versions, threads, history, source information, and measurements. It throws Error when no assembled catalog row has the requested id.
